description: This file contains functions related to retrieving and manipulating MAC addresses from various sources and device partitions, primarily for embedded devices running Linux/OpenWrt systems. It includes methods for extracting MACs from device tree, JSON configuration, partition data, and encrypted sources, as well as utilities for MAC address formatting, generation, and bit manipulation.

methods.name: get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads MAC address binary data from a given file path at a specified offset.

methods.name: get_mac_label_dt
methods.description: Retrieves MAC label from device tree aliases, falling back to reading from /proc/device-tree.

methods.name: get_mac_label_json
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address from /etc/board.json configuration file.

methods.name: get_mac_label
methods.description: Obtains MAC address either from device tree or JSON config, prioritizing device tree.

methods.name: find_mtd_chardev
methods.description: Finds the character device path for a given MTD partition.

methods.name: get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Extracts and canonicalizes a MAC address from a binary partition/string.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Gets MAC address in ASCII form from a specified MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_arcadyan
methods.description: Retrieves an encrypted MAC address from an Arcadyan device partition, decrypting it.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_deco
methods.description: Retrieves a MAC address from a partition with encrypted data, using specific keys.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_uci_config_ubi
methods.description: Reads MAC address from UCI configuration stored in UBI volume.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_text
methods.description: Extracts MAC from binary partition at given offset and length.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC data from a specified MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary_ubi
methods.description: Reads binary MAC from a UBI partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_part_size
methods.description: Returns size of an MTD partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Reads MAC address in ASCII form from an MMC partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address from an MMC partition.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a value to a MAC address (used for generating variations).

methods.name: macaddr_generate_from_mmc_cid
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on the CID of an MMC device.

methods.name: macaddr_geteui
methods.description: Formats MAC address as EUI string with separator.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit
methods.description: Clears a specific bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit_la
methods.description: Sets the 'local administration' bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit_mc
methods.description: Unsets the 'multicast' bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_random
methods.description: Generates a random MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_canonicalize
methods.description: Standardizes different formats of MAC addresses into a canonical form.

methods.name: dt_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a device tree node is enabled (status 'okay').

methods.name: get_linux_version
methods.description: Retrieves and encodes the Linux kernel version number.
